version_notes: v1.1.5 (2026-10-20): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: a capital letter inside a word was read as the start of a new proper noun, so "iOS" gave "OS" and "vCard" gave "Card": fragments the source never has, flagged as new (found finalizing the owner's resume, 2026-10-20). Candidates are now whole words: a lowercase-first word with an inner capital (iOS, vCard, eBay, iPhone) is checked as a whole and is never skipped as a sentence start; its hyphen parts are still checked one by one, so "non-GAAP" still gives "GAAP" and "mid-May" stays quiet. v1.1.4 (2026-10-20): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py, DOCX-shaped text (python-docx paragraph text: no bullet markers, headings are plain Title Case lines). (1) A new Title Case heading ("Earlier Experience") was not reported; only markdown and ALL CAPS headings were. A short Title Case line (1-5 words, optional colon) with a resume-section word (Experience, Education, Skills, ...) now counts as a heading, and is new only if no source line has the same text in any case. Job-title, employer and skill lines are not headings; a heading with no section word is still missed. (2) new_bullets counted only lines that start with a marker, so a new markerless bullet was never counted. When either document has no markers, every non-blank line under a heading now counts in both; lines before the first heading do not, so a headingless letter or claims list stays quiet. Found by the owner's resume reassessment (2026-10-20). That run used the installed 1.1.1 copy; its other two findings (line-start proper nouns, "20" shown with the context of "200+") were already fixed in 1.1.2 but not deployed. v1.1.3 (2026-10-19): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: a new word that starts a bare line was never a proper-noun candidate (any word after a line break was skipped as a sentence start), so a new tool added as its own line in a one-per-line list (SKILLS / Budgeting / Scheduling / Salesforce) gave verdict clean. A word that starts a line, the first line included, is now a candidate unless the text before it ends with . ! or ?; it flags only if the source has it nowhere, in any case, so a truthful reformat stays quiet. Bullet lines and mid-line words were already caught. Pre-existing gap, found while verifying the 26d7738 fix. v1.1.2 (2026-10-19): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: two kinds of reformat noise. (1) A word already in the source was flagged as a new proper noun when a reformat moved it mid-line or capitalized it (one-per-line competencies joined with " | ": Budgeting, Sales, Team). Proposed proper nouns are now compared case-insensitively against every word of the source, wherever it sits. (2) A unit letter (k, M, b) took the first letter of the next word, even across a line break ("20 Mechanics" -> "20 M"), so a rewrapped line changed the token and an old number was flagged as new; the context snippet then came from the first substring match, so "20" showed the context of "200+". Units now count only when no letter follows, and context is taken from a whole-token match. "200+" was already one token. New tools, employers and numbers still flag. Found by the owner's Mode A run (2026-10-19). v1.1.1 (2026-10-18): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: a comma right after a number ("In 2023, four new") was kept as part of the token, so a number or year already in the source was flagged as new ("2023,", "40,"). Trailing commas are now stripped; inner commas ("1,200") are kept and truly new numbers are still flagged. Found by the first live outcome-eval run of interview-prep (2026-10-18). v1.1.0 (2026-10-18) adds the fresh-context drafter-reviewer pass (Mode B step 5): review_pass.py builds a reviewer packet with the posting fenced as untrusted, and checks the reviewer's JSON findings so a quote counts only where it really appears; a posting requirement without a verified source fact becomes a user question, never an edit. Advisory only; verify_no_fabrication stays mandatory and runs last. Ships byte-identical in cover-letter. v1.0.0 is the job-hunter family resume-tailor member, carved from the v5.2.0 monolith's Phase 3 (Tailor Application Materials). THE MOST SAFETY-CRITICAL member: it carries the anti-fabrication HARD GATE. Owns verify_no_fabrication.py (the detection-only fabrication gate, guarded by 5 load-bearing safety tests listed above) plus extract_ats_keywords.py (eval-only, the three-category ATS keyword-gap analysis). Splits Mode A (Tighten/Copyedit, zero-fabrication contract) from Mode B (Tailor for a specific posting, with the mandatory verify_no_fabrication gate). Reads original resume + JD; produces a gated Resume_[Company]_[Role].docx per the family workspace-contract only after every new claim has explicit per-claim user confirmation. The script NEVER auto-approves; auto_approved is always False.
